title: Whether concerts besides opera were given at the French Opera
summary: The interviewer asks about concerts at the French Opera, and Beaulieu says he never attended any.

story.theme_name: Playing for dancers: dance bands and the dances themselves
story.community_name: Dancing to the band: quadrilles, waltzes and dance sets

blocks.x: I'm going to ask once more about the French Opera, if they ever gave any concerts there, like say solo recitals by piano players or the orchestra concerts, if symphonies there or was it always just opera?
Well, I believe they have had occasions when they had concerts there. Of course, I never attended none of them, but I tell you what, they didn't have there.
